entities.name: Darux
entities.description: A Rakdos Spiker and Ringleader from Ravnica, a pierced titan towering over his ring.

entities.name: Vildika
entities.description: Recruited by Darux from Massacre Girl's ring; he fell for her and they host the Slaughter Games.

entities.name: Stroko
entities.description: Goblin whose ring Darux originally belonged to.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: Leader of the ring Vildika was recruited from.

entities.name: Slaughter Games
entities.description: A massive Rakdos parade of chains, cackling and screams hosted by Darux and Vildika.

events.summary: Darux leaves Stroko's ring after a falling out.
events.quote: Darux was originally part of the goblin Stroko 's ring, but left after they had a falling out.

events.summary: Darux recruits Vildika from Massacre Girl's ring and falls for her.
events.quote: he ended up falling for her

events.summary: Darux and Vildika host the Slaughter Games parade.
events.quote: Together, they hosted the Slaughter Games
